name: WirelessHART
description: Wireless field instrumentation communications for process automation; mesh networking adds redundant routes in difficult radio environments of process facilities. Applicable offshore and onshore.

specifications.basis: FieldComm Group WirelessHART technology page, descriptive claim
specifications.value: Each device can act as a router; redundant communication routes extend range and improve reliability

specifications.metric: installation cost reduction vs wired instruments
specifications.basis: FieldComm Group WirelessHART page citing WirelessHART User Case Studies: '30%-60% lower installation costs than adding traditional wired instruments'
HART Protocol Specifications: 2.4GHz DSSS O-QPSK Physical Layer Specification (HCF_SPEC-65 FCG TS20065) Rev. 1.1
specifications.value: 2.4 GHz DSSS O-QPSK, based on IEEE STD 802.15.4-2006 2.4GHz DSSS Physical Layer

specifications.basis: HCF_SPEC-75 FCG TS20075 Rev. 1.2 (TDMA Data-Link Layer)
specifications.value: TDMA Data-Link Layer over IEEE 802.15.4-2006 PHY; secure, reliable, error-free mesh communication
one-way publishing, exception notification, ad-hoc request/response, auto-segmented block transfers

specifications.basis: Page states 'over 99% data reliability' for WirelessHART (IEC 62591) mesh; also 'delivering over 99% data reliability even in environments with interference, extreme temperatures, or physical obstructions'
'WirelessHART® is the global industry standard (IEC 62591) for process automation wireless'
'AES-128 encryption on every message' under 'How is industrial wireless secured against cyber threats?'

'Wireless field devices send data over a secure self-organizing mesh network to a gateway, which translates that data into protocols your DCS, PLC, or SCADA already understands such as HART-IP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP'

specifications.metric: Installation cost saving vs wired instrumentation
specifications.basis: 'Up to 60% lower installation costs vs. traditional wired instrumentation' under 'What ROI can I expect'
'Most industrial wireless deployments deliver payback within 12 to 24 months'
'Emerson Wireless Gateway to aggregate data and connect to your host system (1410S1 or 1410S2)' in tank-level deployment FAQ
'Emerson offers devices certified for use in intrinsically safe and explosion-proof areas under FM, CSA, ATEX, and IECEx standards'

specifications.metric: WirelessHART mesh installation cost saving vs wired instruments
specifications.basis: Quoted on the WirelessHART technology page from the 'WirelessHART User Case Studies - web publishing' brochure: 'WirelessHART offers 30%-60% lower installation costs than adding traditional wired instruments'

As printed on the page: 'By design, WirelessHART using mesh networking technology' and 'a device doesn't have to communicate directly to a gateway, but just forward its message to the next closest device'
specifications.value: self-organizing, self-healing mesh; each device can route for other devices
